verdict.rationale: Databricks Marketplace is documented as an in-platform catalog where customers can discover, evaluate, and connect directly to third-party datasets (plus AI models, notebooks, apps, MCP servers) from within their workspace, and an Open Marketplace variant even works without a workspace. This directly matches the analyst story of enriching own data with third-party datasets inside the platform. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of the enrichment workflow in practice, and no detail on how a discovered dataset is joined/merged with an analyst's own tables.
